title: Have you seen my phone?
instructions: Leo telefonunu arıyor. Kısa bir diyalog; en son nerede olduğuna dikkat et.

script.speaker: leo
script.text: Mia, have you seen my phone? I can't find it anywhere.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: When did you last use it?

script.speaker: leo
script.text: In the kitchen, when I made coffee.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: Let me call it. Listen! It's ringing in your coat pocket.

questions.prompt: Where did Leo last use it?
questions.feedback: En son mutfakta, kahve yaparken kullandı.
questions.evidence: In the kitchen, when I made coffee.

questions.prompt: How does Mia find the phone?

questions.evidence: It's ringing in your coat pocket.
